message.jaymospowers.patrol.warrant_issu: The Galactic Patrol has written a warrant for you: an officer wanted for a crime.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.warrant_grow: Another crime on your Patrol warrant (%1$s now).
message.jaymospowers.patrol.warrant_comi: A Patrol pod is coming down for you.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.came_quietly: You came quietly. Your Patrol warrant is served.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.brought_in: Beaten and brought in. Your Patrol warrant is served.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.partner_fell: Your partner %1$s has fallen. Ask a patrolman for another.
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.quietly: "Smart. We'll call it served. Keep your nose clean from here."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.partnered: "You've earned one. Here's your partner. Watch each other's backs."
